items.q: Are Judaism and Christianity basically the same?
items.correct: No — they share roots but differ; e.g. Judaism does not regard Jesus as the Messiah.
items.why: Both are monotheistic and share scripture, but their core beliefs differ.

items.q: Do all Jewish people practise identically?
items.misconception: Yes, all observe every tradition the same way.
items.why: Jewish communities differ in how they interpret and observe the law.

items.correct: Sacred teaching and law central to Jewish life.
items.why: The Torah guides belief and practice and is treated with great reverence.
